rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance - Chapter 260
rules.requirement: Landlords must comply with rent control regulations administered by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations for properties subject to rent control. Landlords may apply for rent increases through specified procedures including capital improvement applications and hardship rental increase applications.
rules.quoted_span:
The Office of Landlord Tenant Relations administers and enforces the
Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.coverage_conditions: Properties with five or more units in Jersey City
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; superintendent exemption available for buildings with 6 or more units without onsite superintendent; additional exemptions available upon application for exemption request

rule.title: Tenant Right to Challenge Illegal Rent - Illegal Rent Petition
rule.requirement: Tenants claiming the rent they are being charged is illegal may file an Illegal Rent Petition with the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations, providing the landlord with a copy of the petition and all supporting documents.
rule.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code, Chapter 260; Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations procedures
rule.quoted_span: A tenant claiming the rent they are being charged is illegal may file an Illegal Rent Petition: Illegal Rent Petition The Landlord must be provided with a copy of the Petition and all documents.
rule.coverage_conditions: Tenants in properties subject to Jersey City rent control; applies to properties with five or more units
rule.exemptions: 1-4 unit properties exempt from rent control

rule.title: Tenant Right to Challenge Maintenance Issues - Failure to Maintain Service Petition
rule.requirement: A tenant seeking a rent reduction due to the conditions of the building and/or apartment may file a Failure to Maintain Service Petition with the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations, with the landlord provided a copy of the petition and all documents.
rule.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code, Chapter 260; Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations procedures
